_comment: Python half of INV-2 (tech-debt-hardening-plan R-TDH-19, DEC-026). Consumed by `make verify-zero-skips-python` through harness/shared/governance/verify_zero_skips.py --junit-events. A `unique_id_glob` waiver covers every nodeid it matches, but only when the skip reason carries the waiver's decision id; anything else is an unapproved skip. Lives beside the suite because the root .governance/ directory is deliberately dormant (DEC-005). Each glob must be scoped to the class or nodeid that actually carries the skip condition, never to a whole module (gate-truthfulness R-GT-7): a module-wide glob pre-approves skips nobody has written yet, and the decision-id half of the check is satisfied by any reason mentioning the id -- which the reusable POSIX_ONLY marker's reason already does.
